name: Swedish Institute Scholarship for Global Professionals (SISGP)
amount: Full tuition (paid directly to the university) + SEK 12,000/month living allowance (check official page for travel grant and insurance)
dlText: SI application 8–24 Feb 2027, closes 14:59 CET; you must first apply to an eligible master's programme via University Admissions by 15 Jan 2027
fields: Eligible one- and two-year master's programmes in Sweden (list published 13 Nov 2026)
note: About 350–400 awards a year. Eligibility depends on citizenship, not residence; you must be admitted to a programme on SI's eligible list. The 2027/28 country list has 34 countries.
